# infer layout: find separator rows/cols = rows/cols all equal to some single color != others
def analyze(i,o,name):
    h,w=i.shape
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(map(int,i[r])))==1]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len(set(map(int,i[:,c])))==1]
    print(name,'seprows',sep_rows,'sepcols',sep_cols)
    # cells whose row is not sep row but col is sep col? these stay 0 in demo3
    return sep_rows,sep_cols
for n in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    sr,sc=analyze(np.array(G[n+' input']),np.array(G[n+' output']))
    # classify changed cells by relationship
    ni=np.array(G[n+' input']); no=np.array(G[n+' output'])
    ch=[(r,c,int(ni[r][c]),int(no[r][c])) for r in range(ni.shape[0]) for c in range(ni.shape[1]) if ni[r][c]!=no[r][c]]
    chsr={abs(r) for r,c,x,y in [(a[0],None,a[2],a[3]) for a in ch]}.union({0})
    print(' changes by relation:')
    tab=[[0]*(3+2) for _ in range(3)]
    for r,c,x,y in ch:
        rr=(r//5)%10
        cc=r%10
        key=(rr,cc,x,y)
        cnt=tab[key[0]][key[1]]
